The studio

About PinkRyno Studios

PinkRyno Studios is a tiny independent studio in Florida. We make games for children ages 3 to 6: short, colorful, and calm enough to hand over.

Rosie Ryno, our baby pink rhino, is the studio mascot. She loves stars, gentle adventures, and cheering on little explorers.

What we hold to

  • A child can start playing right away. The games are short, colorful, and calm enough to hand over.
  • Tiny Trails is our series of tracing games. Follow the glowing path at your own pace, and find a star at the end.
  • If a game has more to open, it is a one-time unlock. No subscription and no surprise cart.

Made for little hands, with no ads and nothing to sign up for. The details are in the privacy policy.

Tiny Trails: Space is the first theme: cosmic worlds, a glowing trail, and a star at the end.
